text:
Jordan: heads-up — after the 1709003000 frontend deploy I'm seeing a big main-thread parse spike on the console. sparklines/thumbnails chugging when many rows render. noticed in PROD US only so far.
Priya: thanks. do we have a perf trace or flamegraph?
Jordan: yep, attaching quick trace snippet from Sentry CPU profiler. parse time for entry bundle went from ~120ms -> ~450ms on first paint.
Maria: checking bundle stats now. build artifact sizes changed unexpectedly in the canary:
```
entry.console.js: 5.8MB (was 2.1MB)
vendor.3rdparty.js: 3.7MB
sparkline-thumb.js: 1.1MB  // used to be ~80KB async chunk
```
Alex: that looks like the sparkline thumbnail lib was inlined into the entry chunk — probable cause is the new rollup/webpack config switch that happened in the same PR.
Ben: which PR changed the bundler config? any link?
Jordan: PR #4528 by @Alex earlier today — the change altered "splitChunks" heuristics and also pinned a new babel plugin.
Alex: I pushed a small change to the split config to avoid extra requests in low-LCP paths but i must've mis-scoped it, sorry. quick fix: revert splitChunks tweak and re-run build.
Priya: can we hotfix without full rollback? maybe async load the sparkline thumbnails with a dynamic import to reduce main parse?
Alex: yes, dynamic import will help immediately. we can also add a forced vendor split rule for third-party libs.
Maria: telemetry shows 3x higher FCP for dashboards with >50 rows in US region since deploy. EU canary is fine (we didn't route traffic there).
Ben: does routing/quotas factor in? maybe traffic shaping to EU would mask it but not fix. we should avoid routing tricks for perf regressions.
deploy-bot: deploy 1709003000 to prod/us completed by CI (sha abcd123).
Jordan: can someone run a build compare locally? `npx build-stats --json` and compare asset list. I can try but busy on call.
Alex: i'm on it, creating PR to revert split change + async import for sparkline-thumb. will add a canary rollout to 10% first.
Priya: add telemetry metric for parse time bucketed by bundle version so we can catch this in future. also add alert if entry bundle >3MB.
Maria: opening an incident doc now and will drop traces + screenshots. tagging @frontend-ops for follow-up.
Ben: quick mitigation — disable sparkline thumbnails in high-cardinality views via feature flag? that would be immediate and low-risk.
Jordan: good idea, flip flag for US dashboards until canary verifies fix.
Alex: PR: #4532 created — revert split change + dynamic import. starting canary to 10% US.
Maria: canary metrics look promising after 10m: entry parse back down to ~130ms. rolling to 50%.
Priya: great. follow-up actions: 1) rollback if anything spikes, 2) add bundle-size gating to CI, 3) perf postmortem.
Jordan: thanks team — i'll post a short blameless postmortem and add the CI gating item to the sprint. :thumbsup:
Maria: noted, will attach telemetry dashboards to the postmortem.
Alex: sorry again — will be more careful with split rules. will also add a small integration test to detect inlined libs.
Ben: sounds good. moving the feature flag and monitoring until fully rolled out. :white_check_mark:
